evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

prohibited_failures: Ambiguous obligation resolved instead of counsel-flagged

cases.name: Build the obligations matrix
cases.query: Extract all rights and obligations from this SaaS services agreement into a structured matrix. We are the customer.
files: a SaaS agreement with delivery, uptime (best-efforts), payment, support, audit rights, and suspension rights
baseline_risks: Writes a prose summary; misses conditions, mislabels best-efforts uptime as a hard SLA, omits the vendor's suspension right
expected_behavior: Structured matrix with obligor/obligee/act/trigger/deadline/consequence per obligation, cited
Preserves 'commercially reasonable efforts' on uptime rather than stating a guaranteed SLA
Extracts vendor suspension and customer audit rights
must_not: Convert a best-efforts obligation into a hard guarantee

cases.name: Subjective trigger
cases.query: Map the obligations in this consulting agreement.
files: agreement where the client's payment obligation is triggered 'upon acceptance of deliverables, in Client's sole discretion'
baseline_risks: Records 'client pays on acceptance' without flagging that acceptance is at sole discretion (an unmeasurable, one-sided trigger)
expected_behavior: Extracts the payment obligation with its actual trigger
Flags 'sole discretion' acceptance as a subjective standard creating consultant risk
Keeps the flag in the risk layer; notes it may warrant counsel/negotiation
must_not: State the payment obligation as unconditional

cases.name: Interdependency chain
cases.query: What has to happen, and in what order, under this development agreement? Extract the obligations.
files: agreement where developer must deliver, then customer has 15 days to test/accept, then payment is due 30 days after acceptance, with a cure chain on rejection
baseline_risks: Lists the three obligations independently; the acceptance-gated payment chain and cure loop are not connected
expected_behavior: Extracts each obligation and links the interdependency chain (deliver -> test/accept -> pay)
Captures the rejection/cure branch and its timing
Deadlines and conditions cited per step
must_not: Present payment as due on a fixed date independent of acceptance

cases.name: Buried one-sided obligation
cases.query: Quick extract of the main obligations in this reseller agreement — the important ones.
files: agreement with a buried clause obligating the reseller to purchase minimum quantities each quarter or forfeit its territory, easy to overlook among routine terms
baseline_risks: Extracts the obvious obligations; misses the buried minimum-purchase-or-forfeit-territory obligation
expected_behavior: Systematically extracts all obligations including the buried minimum-purchase commitment
Captures its trigger (quarterly), standard (minimum quantity), and severe consequence (territory forfeiture)
Flags it in the risk layer as material and onerous

cases.name: Fairness opinion, not extraction
cases.query: Is the payment schedule in this contract fair to us, and what should we push back on?
baseline_risks: Skill could produce a full obligations matrix for a fairness/negotiation question
expected_behavior: Recognizes a payment-fairness/negotiation question; routes to payment-compensation-analysis and contract-negotiation-strategy
must_not: Produce a whole-contract obligations matrix for a targeted fairness question
